text.p: The Athens bourse gave the green light on Thursday for the 1.676 billion drachma share capital increase of ore processor Silver&Baryte which will be used to acquire affiliated Bauxites Parnasse, it said in a statement.
Silver&Baryte will issue 2,660,650 new common bearer shares with a par value of 630 drachmas which will subsequently be swaped one-for-one with the entire share capital of absorbed Bauxites Parnasse.
The ratio of equity capital between Silver&Baryte and Bauxites Parnasse, Europe's largest bauxite producer, stands at 2.35:1.
Silver&Baryte is expected to post a 16 percent drop in 1996 pre-tax earnings to 2.566 billion on turnover growth of 33 percent to 17.581 billion.
The drop in profit is attributed to a 1.1 billion drachma extraordinary provision item for redundancies in Bauxites Parnasse as part of an extensive cost rationalisation plan.
Management has stated it would keep dividend per share unchanged at 140 drachmas for fiscal 1996.
Shares of Silver&Baryte gained 105 drachmas to 4,530 on Thursday on volume of 29,130 shares. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
